# `brand` — `/api/brand`

A Grove's identity: its name and words, colours, type, corners, logo and login picture.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/brand`](#get-api-brand) | Anyone | The Grove's name, tagline, colours, links and picture addresses, for the sign-in and members' pages. |
| GET | [`/api/brand/logo`](#get-api-brand-logo) | Anyone | The Grove's logo. |
| GET | [`/api/brand/look`](#get-api-brand-look) | Grove owner | The Grove's look as saved, with each setting described (Grove owners). |
| PUT | [`/api/brand/look`](#put-api-brand-look) | Grove owner | Saves the Grove's look (Grove owners). |
| DELETE | [`/api/brand/look`](#delete-api-brand-look) | Grove owner | Back to the host's settings. |
| POST | [`/api/brand/look/from-site`](#post-api-brand-look-from-site) | Grove owner | What a website in Files looks like: suggestions to review, nothing saved. |
| POST | [`/api/brand/look/preview`](#post-api-brand-look-preview) | Grove owner | The theme a changed look would give, without saving it (Grove owners). |
| PUT | [`/api/brand/look/{kind}`](#put-api-brand-look-kind) | Grove owner | Replaces the Grove's logo or sign-in picture (Grove owners); the request body is the image itself. |
| DELETE | [`/api/brand/look/{kind}`](#delete-api-brand-look-kind) | Grove owner | No logo, or no login picture, whatever the host's settings say. |
| POST | [`/api/brand/look/{kind}/from-file`](#post-api-brand-look-kind-from-file) | Grove owner | A picture from Files, such as the logo on the Grove's website. |
| GET | [`/api/brand/picture`](#get-api-brand-picture) | Anyone | The Grove's sign-in picture. |

<a id="get-api-brand"></a>
### `GET /api/brand`

The Grove's name, tagline, colours, links and picture addresses, for the sign-in and members' pages. Needs no sign-in.

- Handler: [`brand`](../../../backend/brand.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `branded`, `name`, `tagline`, `accent`, `theme`, `site_url`, `site_label`, `shop_url`, `shop_label`, `logo_url`, `picture_url`

<a id="get-api-brand-logo"></a>
### `GET /api/brand/logo`

The Grove's logo. Needs no sign-in.

- Handler: [`brand_logo`](../../../backend/brand.py)

- `200`: a raw body, with the upstream's type

<a id="put-api-brand-look"></a>
### `PUT /api/brand/look`

Saves the Grove's look (Grove owners).

- Handler: [`save_look`](../../../backend/brand.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Look`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | `""` | at most 200 characters |
| `tagline` | string | no | `""` | at most 400 characters |
| `background` | string | no | `""` | at most 7 characters |
| `text` | string | no | `""` | at most 7 characters |
| `accent` | string | no | `""` | at most 7 characters |
| `login_background` | string | no | `""` | at most 7 characters |
| `font_heading` | one of `"clean"`, `"rounded"`, `"classic"`, `"bold"` | no | `"clean"` |  |
| `font_body` | one of `"clean"`, `"rounded"`, `"classic"` | no | `"clean"` |  |
| `corners` | one of `"round"`, `"soft"`, `"square"` | no | `"round"` |  |
| `logo_shape` | one of `"original"`, `"circle"` | no | `"original"` |  |
| `site_url` | string | no | `""` | at most 2048 characters |
| `site_label` | string | no | `""` | at most 200 characters |
| `shop_url` | string | no | `""` | at most 2048 characters |
| `shop_label` | string | no | `""` | at most 200 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `look`, `custom`, `theme`, `logo_url`, `picture_url`, `sizes`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only the Grove’s owners can do this. | `grove_owner` |
| 422 | Choose a background colour to go with the others. | `checked` |
